stemMd: In a warehouse, damaged items are 3% of all items. There are 485 undamaged items. How many items are there altogether?
explanationMd: Undamaged items make up 97%, so total=485/0.97=500. The damaged count is 15, providing a check.

distractorRationale.a: Subtracts damage instead of adding it back.
distractorRationale.d: Adds 30 items without using the percentage relationship.
distractorRationale.b: Adds 3% of undamaged stock rather than recovering the original base.
